title: TEPHRA on this laptop: Agung and Sakurajima (synthetic demo data)
about: Every model step runs on Gemma served by Ollama on this computer: no API key, no quota. The case is invented data on real places (data/replay/demo-agung-20261014), labelled so on every page. Read by scripts/demo_local.py.

beats.do: Open the Wall. Point at the clock: "Replay · synthetic demo data".
beats.see: Agung, Bali. Pink = official ash area. Amber dashed = TEPHRA's estimate, never smaller. Amber planes head into it.
beats.say: An invented eruption on a real volcano, with every kind of source TEPHRA reads.

beats.do: Open Details › Where the sources disagree.
beats.see: The observatory puts the ash higher than the SIGMET, and moving south while the SIGMET says west.
beats.say: The official sources disagree. Code labels every difference; the airline has to reconcile them.

beats.see: The Plume reader's reading, marked "Drafted by TEPHRA Assistant".
beats.say: The assistant weighs the evidence and may only widen the official area, never shrink it.

beats.do: Click an amber plane minutes from the ash.
beats.see: Minutes to entry, its draft (HOLD, DIVERT, CHANGE LEVEL or REROUTE) and the route around the ash.
beats.say: The Flight planner chose the action; code drew the route and checked every number.

beats.do: Area menu (top bar) › Kyushu. Open Details › Where the sources disagree.
beats.see: Sakurajima: Tokyo's "ash dissipated" advisory is still in force while JMA reports a new eruption. A CONFLICT.
beats.say: Japan too: JMA's eruption notice against the Tokyo advisory, flagged as a conflict.

beats.do: Press A. Press Play, then the speed button for 60x.
beats.see: The Coordinator hands out the work: Plume reader, Flight planner, Drafter, each step timed.
beats.say: That is the assistant at work, running entirely on Gemma on this laptop.

beats.do: Open the Desk, sign in as Dispatcher with the PIN, open a draft and hold to approve.
beats.see: The draft, its reasons, "Drafted by TEPHRA Assistant", then the record line with its hash.
beats.say: A person approves every advisory, and every decision lands in a hash-chained record.

beats.do: Ask: "Which flights enter the ash in the next 15 minutes?"
beats.see: The flights and their minutes, looked up from TEPHRA's own data.
beats.say: Ask is an agent with tools: it looks the numbers up rather than guessing them.

beats.do: Open the airport recovery plan (Bali closed).
beats.see: Bali, Malang and Lombok closed; the re-planned flights, waiting for approval.
beats.say: When ash closes airports, the Recovery planner re-plans the day's flights.

beats.see: How an airline plugs its own flights in.
beats.say: Decision support only: official areas stay binding, and a person decides.
